## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The failure-report selector should normalize paths before matching because dot-prefixed paths are incorrectly excluded.

## Changes
The pull request adds selection from failure reports, refactors cached selection, and adds selector tests. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/selection.py:20 — correctness — Normalize dot-prefixed failure paths before matching — With `{"failed": ["./tests/test_x.py"]}` and requested `{"tests/test_x.py"}`, you return `[]`. The explicit selector normalizes paths before matching, establishing support for this spelling. — Callers receive an incomplete selection when failure reports use dot-prefixed paths. — Fix: Compare `normalize(path)` with `requested` while preserving `path` in the result.
